name: Mail Order Bride
source:
"Mail Order Bride" is a short GxB story set in the American West during the 1860s. You play the titular character, Temperance Adams, a young Bostonian schoolteacher who has decided to move West and marry a man she has never met, but only spoken with through postal communication. However, when she arrives, she discovers she has to deal with a set of totally unforeseen circumstances...what will she do?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=7142]Official thread[/url]]
